decks.notes: This deck focuses on controlling the game using a combination of powerful elemental creatures and disruptive spells. It aims to generate value through cards like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation, while using counterspells, removal, and cards like Teferi, Time Raveler to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With the help of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion, the deck can generate even more value by blinking its creatures and permanents. Additionally, the mana base is carefully crafted to support the various color requirements of the deck's spells.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through countering spells, drawing cards, and generating value with cards like Wrenn and Six and Shark Typhoon. The deck aims to stall the game until it can establish a strong board presence with Wilderness Reclamation, allowing it to generate mana and cast powerful spells like Nexus of Fate and Expansion / Explosion. Additionally, the deck utilizes various lands to fix its mana base and provide additional utility. Overall, the strategy revolves around maintaining control of the game and outvaluing the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly flooding the board with goblin creatures to overwhelm the opponent and deal damage as efficiently as possible. It benefits from tribal synergies and has a few combo pieces like Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker and Conspicuous Snoop to generate extra value and create explosive turns. The inclusion of Aether Vial helps to cheat creatures into play and maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to be fast, aggressive, and relentless in its pursuit of victory through overwhelming force and clever combos.

The deck focuses on utilizing disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to control the opponent's hand, while also applying pressure with efficient threats like Tarmogoyf and Kroxa. The deck also utilizes planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Wrenn and Six to generate card advantage and control the board. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive playstyle of the deck, with a focus on generating both black and red mana. Overall, the deck aims to maintain a strong tempo and pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan.

The deck focuses on controlling the game using a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. It aims to outvalue the opponent with cards like Abundant Growth and Expressive Iteration while generating incremental advantage with cards like Ice-Fang Coatl and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also utilizes the Companion Yorion, Sky Nomad to provide additional card advantage and value. Overall, the deck aims to control the game's pace, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and eventually win through card advantage and powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation.

The primary idea behind this deck is to maintain control over the game by utilizing a wide range of powerful control cards. The deck includes a variety of creature and spell options, including powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, to consistently control the board state. With a focus on tempo and disruption, the deck aims to outvalue opponents by generating card advantage and utilizing powerful synergy between cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Restoration Angel. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the various color requirements of the deck.

The deck revolves around cycling creatures and using cards like Violent Outburst and Living End to put them onto the battlefield all at once, overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of powerful creatures. The goal is to quickly cycle through the deck to find the combo pieces needed to execute the Living End strategy, while also using cards like Force of Negation to protect your game plan. With a mix of cyclers, cascade spells, and disruptive elements, the deck aims to create explosive turns and quickly close out the game.

This Modern Big Red Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with powerful red control spells like Blood Moon, Abrade, and Ensnaring Bridge while deploying threats like Chandra, Karn, and Ragavan to close out the game. The deck also utilizes cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Fury for card advantage and removal. By locking down the opponent's mana base and board presence while maintaining a steady stream of threats, this deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent in the long run.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful creatures. It utilizes cards like Ice-Fang Coatl and Solitude for card advantage and protection, while also having access to powerful threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The deck also includes a variety of versatile spells like Prismatic Ending and Lightning Bolt for removal, as well as planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Jace, the Mind Sculptor for additional control and card advantage. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's diverse range of spells and ensure consistent mana production.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling a powerful combination of equipment and creatures, utilizing cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin to cheat out Colossus Hammer onto the battlefield. The key strategy is to equip a creature with Colossus Hammer, making it a huge threat that can deal massive amounts of damage and potentially win the game in just a few swings. The deck also includes protection spells like Spell Pierce and ways to tutor for key pieces with Urza's Saga, creating a fast and explosive win condition.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of disruption and value-generating cards. It utilizes a combination of hand disruption spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, along with efficient removal like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt. The deck also includes threats like Tarmogoyf, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Wrenn and Six, Traverse the Ulvenwald, and Mishra's Bauble provide card advantage and consistency. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while presenting a fast and proactive game plan.

The deck relies on cycling through powerful creatures to discard them into the graveyard, then casting Living End to bring them all back into play at once. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden army of creatures, utilizing cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to facilitate the cycling strategy. The inclusion of Grief and Shardless Agent provide additional disruption and card advantage. With the right setup, the deck can quickly swing the game in its favor and secure victory through a powerful combo turn.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and then bringing them back into play using cards like Unburial Rites and Persist. The deck also has disruption and card draw elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and Mulldrifter to help control the game. By combining reanimation with card advantage and disruption, the deck aims to overpower opponents with its high-impact creatures and versatile spells.

Utilizing powerful Tron lands to quickly ramp into mana and play large threats, this Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with removal and graveyard hate while ultimately winning the game with devastating planeswalkers and Eldrazi creatures. The key strategy is to assemble UrzaTron as quickly as possible to overwhelm opponents with powerful threats and control elements, creating a strong board presence and dominating the late game. By combining efficient ramp, removal, and game-winning threats, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in a grindy game of attrition.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using powerful counterspells, removal spells, and planeswalkers to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion adds a unique twist to the control archetype. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan and eventually establish dominance with powerful finishers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and March of Otherworldly Light. By controlling the board and the opponent's resources, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw effects to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Jace, and The Wandering Emperor to generate card advantage and outvalue the opponent. The deck includes a mix of creature removal, card draw, and land disruption to control the board and outmaneuver the opponent's threats. The companion Kaheera adds an additional creature for utility and resilience. Overall, the deck aims to control the game's pace and resources until it can win with its powerful finishers.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using a variety of counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also includes cards that provide card advantage and allow for flexibility in gameplay. The inclusion of the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad indicates a focus on a longer game, utilizing the ability to repeatedly blink permanents for value. The mana base is designed to support a diverse range of spells and colors, ensuring the deck can cast its spells efficiently and consistently throughout the game.

This deck aims to quickly ramp up its mana and play Primeval Titan to search for powerful lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion to deal massive damage to the opponent. The key strategy involves utilizing Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and generate extra mana, allowing for explosive plays and combo potential. With the right setup, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent with its efficient mana generation and powerful land interactions, leading to a swift victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game with cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Teferi, Time Raveler while ramping up mana with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove. The key win condition is to utilize Scapeshift to search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and a number of Mountains to deal massive damage to the opponent. Bring to Light allows for flexibility in finding key cards, and Wrenn and Six provides additional value by recurring lands from the graveyard. Overall, the deck aims to control the board until it can execute the Scapeshift combo for victory.

This deck focuses on overwhelming opponents with quick, aggressive plays while utilizing Cascade mechanics to maximize efficiency. By cascading into powerful spells like Violent Outburst and Crashing Footfalls, the deck aims to flood the board with creatures and disruptive spells to control the game tempo. With a mix of tempo plays like Brazen Borrower and versatile spells like Archmage's Charm, the deck aims to pressure opponents early and maintain board presence until victory. With a few lands that can produce multiple colors of mana, the deck can cast a wide variety of spells to adapt to different situations.

This deck aims to generate value through cascade effects, utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cast multiple spells for free. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays while maintaining control through cards like Force of Negation and Subtlety. The deck also includes versatile spells like Prismari Command and Dead / Gone to handle various threats. The mana base is designed to support the cascade mechanic, while also providing access to different colors for flexibility in casting spells.

This deck focuses on quickly casting Cascade spells to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of creatures and spells. The goal is to cascade into powerful cards like Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. Utilizing cards like Mystical Dispute and Force of Negation helps to protect your board while disrupting the opponent's game plan. Additionally, cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Brazen Borrower provide flexibility in dealing with threats or supporting your own aggressive strategy. The deck also includes land disruption with options like Blood Moon and Otawara, Soaring City to further disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful threats like Archon of Cruelty while also using a mix of control elements like Remand and Prismatic Ending to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck incorporates cards like Faithful Mending and Persist to maintain card advantage and resilience. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while also maximizing the chances of hitting Dwarven Mine for additional creature tokens. The inclusion of Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional utility and flexibility to the deck.

The deck focuses on utilizing +1/+1 counters and artifact creatures to quickly build a threatening board presence. Cards like Hardened Scales and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp help to maximize the value of counters placed on creatures like Walking Ballista and Hangarback Walker. Urza's Saga is a key component for finding artifacts and The Ozolith helps to transfer counters between creatures. With a mix of ramp, protection, and utility lands, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful, synergistic creatures and take advantage of the modular nature of artifact creatures.

This deck focuses on utilizing Hardened Scales to maximize the value of +1/+1 counters on creatures, allowing for aggressive plays with creatures like Walking Ballista, Hangarback Walker, and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp. The deck also includes artifacts like Arcbound Ravager and Patchwork Automaton to further capitalize on the counters strategy. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the aggressive nature of the deck while also providing access to important utility lands like Urza's Saga and Academy Ruins. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient creatures and potent synergies.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game using a combination of powerful Elementals and disruptive spells. The deck aims to ramp up mana quickly with cards like Abundant Growth and Utopia Sprawl while using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck utilizes Elemental synergies with cards like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation to generate card advantage and pressure the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of Elemental creatures and control spells to disrupt opponent's strategies and maintain board control. By incorporating cards that can generate value upon entering the battlefield or when leaving it, along with powerful control cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismatic Ending, the deck aims to outvalue opponents while disrupting their game plan. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional flexibility and value throughout the game. Additionally, the deck utilizes a diverse mana base to ensure consistent access to its powerful spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful Elemental creatures and control spells to control the game's tempo and out-value the opponent. The deck includes various ways to generate card advantage through cards like Mulldrifter and Ephemerate, while also having removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats. Additionally, the deck includes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to provide additional utility and value. The deck also utilizes the Companion mechanic by including Yorion, Sky Nomad to provide additional card advantage and resilience in longer games.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly deploy a high number of artifact creatures and utilize Cranial Plating and Nettlecyst to enhance their power and toughness, turning them into lethal threats. The deck also features various support cards like Springleaf Drum and Thoughtcast to ensure a smooth and efficient gameplay. Additionally, Urza's Saga is included to tutor for important artifacts like Shadowspear and Pithing Needle. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive plays utilizing the synergy between artifacts and creatures.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on playing low-cost spells and creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck includes cheap removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, as well as counterspells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell to protect its threats. The deck also features card draw and selection with cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble. The creatures in the deck, such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, are efficient and aggressive, allowing the deck to apply pressure early in the game.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents with cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon to slow down their mana base, while also ramping up its own resources with Utopia Sprawl and Arbor Elf. It aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Bonecrusher Giant, while generating card advantage with Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Wrenn and Six to further control the game. Karn, the Great Creator is included to shut down artifact-based strategies and provide additional utility.

This deck is focused on maintaining control of the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. By using cards like Archmage's Charm, Counterspell, and Teferi, Time Raveler, the goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan and prevent them from resolving key threats. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Shark Typhoon and The Wandering Emperor to close out the game once control has been established. With a mix of removal, counterspells, and card draw, this UW Control deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver its opponents in a game of attrition.
